description: A bounded real-game comparison set selected to contrast a one-pitch plate appearance with a multi-event, multi-runner plate appearance.

samples.description: Eduardo Escobar flies out to right fielder Franmil Reyes in foul territory.
samples.reviewRationale: Minimal explicit event structure: one pitch and one terminal runner record.

samples.description: Alex Avila singles on a line drive to right fielder Franmil Reyes. Ketel Marte scores.
samples.reviewRationale: Long pitch sequence plus multiple runner records and a scoring transition.
